name: Editorial Desk
note: A newsroom CMS whose draft, review, approved, scheduled and live states are a small state machine: the publish checklist, the available actions and the @property-animated workflow track are all derived from the entry on every edit, scheduling blocks taken slots, and transitions go on an undo stack. Set --acm-editor-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Media Library
note: A brand asset library where one focal point drives every crop: thumbnails and the 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 previews are panned with transform from the same clamp math, so dragging the point re-frames them all at once. Range and toggle selection, bulk move and delete with undo, simulated and real drag-and-drop uploads, and a storage meter summed from the files. Set --acm-media-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Roles & Permissions
note: A role editor whose permission matrix is a subgrid table with dependency rules: granting Publish pulls in Edit and View, revoking View clears the row, and each cascade ripples across the cells with a --i stagger. Unsaved changes are diffed against the saved roles, compared against a second role, guarded against locking yourself out, and member role changes keep every count in sync. Set --acm-roles-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Audit Log
note: A security audit log where a token query (actor:, action:, sev:, ip:), faceted counts that exclude their own group, and a brushable stacked histogram all filter the same seeded event set, so the bars, the facet numbers and the list always agree. Bars rescale with transform, rows expand to show the change diff, and live tail pauses off screen. Set --acm-audit-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Moderation Queue
note: A keyboard-first trust-and-safety queue: A, R, E and S decide, number keys pick the removal reason, Z undoes, and each decision throws the card out along its own transform path while the next one enters with @starting-style. Classifier spans are highlighted in the content, SLA countdowns tick only while visible, and the session tally bar is the sum of the decisions. Set --acm-modq-h to 100dvh in an app.
html: Patchwork MarketTrust & Safety · queue

name: Navigation Editor
note: A site-menu editor with a pointer-driven sortable tree: vertical position picks the slot and horizontal offset projects the depth (clamped by the neighbours and a three-level limit), drops settle with a FLIP animation, and Tab, Shift+Tab and Alt+arrows do the same from the keyboard. The live header preview renders from the same tree and selects back into it, and publishing is blocked while a path is invalid. Set --acm-navtree-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Redirect Manager
note: A redirect manager that compiles :param and * patterns into first-match-wins rules and statically analyses them: a live path tester traces every hop, and each rule is checked for chains, loops, shadowing by an earlier rule and dead destinations, with a one-click fix for each (flatten, disable, move up). Reorders animate with FLIP, the 30-day hit total is the sum of the per-rule sparklines, and CSV import validates line by line. Set --acm-redirects-h to 100dvh in an app.
html: Larkspur PressSite · Redirects

name: Environment Settings
note: Project settings layered as base values plus per-environment overrides: every row shows whether it inherits or overrides, resets back to base, and edits stay pending until a review step that, for production, asks you to type the project slug. Switching environment animates a registered --acm-envs-hue so the whole frame re-tints, and a compare view diffs all four layers and promotes staging to production. Set --acm-envs-h to 100dvh in an app.
